response.overview: The heroine of this New Year’s tale, Gohar, is one of those rare lucky people who seem to have everything fall into place effortlessly. But…  At a luxurious mountain resort, the perfect setting for a winter getaway, one accidental kiss on the eve of New Year’s transfers her good fortune to a charming musician named Hayk. From that moment on, both their lives are turned upside down.
response.title: Սերը լեռներում
